group_type.title: Group type
group_type.label: Type
group_type.description: The group type decides how subjects and the schedule work.

regular.title: Standard group
regular.description: Grades 1–10, simple control over subjects and the schedule for individual classes

abitur.title: Abitur group
abitur.description: Upper school, advanced control over courses and schedules for whole year groups

modal.title: Change group type?
modal.message_regular: Lessons keep the course they are scheduled for, but new subjects use the core, elective and extra categories again and courses lose their GK/LK/ZK type. Existing subjects keep their category until you edit them.
modal.message_abitur: Every subject becomes course-based and each course gets a GK or LK type, or ZK below an additional subject. Existing subjects and lessons stay as they are until you edit them.

group_type.failed: Failed to update the group type

dalton.title: Dalton
dalton.description: Dalton adds independent study time to the schedule and its own task type.
dalton.toggle_description: Dalton becomes a task type and can be scheduled like a subject. Subjects can be marked as Dalton subjects.

modal.title: Disable Dalton?
modal.message: All Dalton lessons are removed from the schedule and no new Dalton tasks can be created. Existing Dalton tasks and the Dalton flags on subjects are kept.

dalton.failed: Failed to update the Dalton setting

info.headline: Manage members of your group
info.list_text: Here you can see all members of your group along with their role (Owner, Admin, Moderator, Member). To protect user data, an automatically generated alias is displayed. Your own entry is marked with “You”.
info.role_text: The dropdown next to each member shows their current role. You can only manage members below you and only assign roles below your own; everything else is grayed out. You can lower your own role at any time. The owner and superadmins can do everything. If they choose “Owner” for someone, ownership is transferred and the previous owner becomes an admin.
info.remove_text: To remove a member from the group, click on the corresponding icon next to the dropdown menu. Here too, you can only remove members below you. The owner cannot be removed.

remove_modal.title: Remove Member?
remove_modal.confirm: Are you sure you want to remove {name} from the group?
remove_modal.rejoin_info: Users can rejoin at any time if they receive an invite link for your group. To block them from doing so, you can ban them.

transfer_modal.title: Transfer Ownership?
transfer_modal.message_as_owner: Do you really want to transfer ownership of this group to {name}? You will become an admin and lose your owner rights.
transfer_modal.message_take_over: Do you want to take over ownership of this group? {owner} will lose their owner rights and become an admin.
transfer_modal.message_on_behalf: Do you want to transfer ownership of this group to {name}? {owner} will lose their owner rights and become an admin.

step_down_modal.title: Lower your own role?
step_down_modal.message: You cannot give this role back to yourself afterwards. Someone with a higher role will have to do that.
